strategyExplain.quality: First entry in your priority order wins. Predictable and user-controlled.
strategyExplain.reliability: Prefers deployments with enough healthy samples, then success rate, P95 latency, and current load.
strategyExplain.speed: Lowest recent P95 latency wins, based on deployment-level health metrics.
